tool_args.rationale: The archive identifies a nonlinear sink-coupled base, while the long-horizon measurements establish a slow reversal. Combining that base with a saturating negative adaptation term yields a five-parameter stationary mechanism to fit and test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Pure dual-exponential response with sink dependence
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The prior submission was refuted on fresh confirmation; it may omit the independently supported nonlinear siphon base.
It cannot explain the observed change from positive to negative with horizon.
Eleven observations now span short and long horizons and varied sink gradients, sufficient to fit and test this five-parameter candidate.
